question: On a fourth prior-file-disjoint public-image batch, can reciprocal reference-to-query patch support spatially attach entrance proposals to the requested POI and produce correct unique entrance commits without OCR?

fresh_multifacet_library.selection_authority: Commons filename metadata before pixel access; every multifacet-v1, v2, and v3 file excluded. Central Station had no additional eligible file in the source category.

source_audit.positive_definition: A distinct pedestrian door or destination-bound entry aperture is visibly actionable in the current image.
source_audit.negative_definition: Historical/distant context, an object, or a target-context view without a distinct actionable current-view entry choice.
source_audit.limitations: Current-image aperture truth only; no public-access, accessibility, traversability, metric-distance, safe-approach, or arrival authority.

grounding_dino.prompt: pedestrian entrance. building entrance. station entrance. doorway. gate. stairs. escalator. passageway.

target_support_field.configuration: Use unchanged SupportFieldConfig defaults in named_poi_target_support_field.py.
target_support_field.construction: For every target reference, retain reciprocal DINO patch matches consistent with one affine RANSAC layout; take the strongest target support per query patch; subtract the strongest distractor support; normalize the positive goal margin field.
target_support_field.attachment: A proposal attaches to target support inside its fixed 1.5-width box extended one proposal-height upward. Support score is 0.60 field-mass fraction plus 0.40 local peak; combine harmonically with entrance score.
target_support_field.states: COMMIT for one separated eligible edge, SET_VALUED for close edges, SEARCH when no entrance is attached to discriminative target support.

evaluation.baseline: Commit the maximum GroundingDINO bound-score proposal when its score is at least 0.10.
evaluation.successor: Commit only the entrance selected by the frozen target-support-field reducer.
evaluation.stop_condition: Run once. Retain as a locator only if it makes at least one correct unique commit, strictly improves correct commits over the generic baseline, and reduces false commits. Otherwise do not tune this cohort.
